description: General commercial invoice extraction for vendor invoices. Extracts vendor name, invoice dates, invoice number, PO or job reference, GST amounts, total amount, service address, and operational routing fields.

vendor_name.description: Name of the company, supplier, contractor, tradesperson, service provider, utility, or vendor issuing the invoice and requesting payment. Usually appears near the logo, top header, remittance details, or vendor contact block. Do not return the customer, Invoice To party, Bill To party, property manager, property owner, tenant, attention line, technician, or contact person.

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued. May be labeled Invoice Date, Date, Billing Date, Issue Date, Tax Invoice Date, or Statement Date. Return the date printed on the invoice, not the payment due date, service date, or delivery date.

payment_due_date.description: Date when payment is due. May be labeled Due Date, Payment Due Date, Payable By, Due On, Terms Due Date, or Balance Due Date. Return only an explicitly printed calendar date. Do not infer a due date from invoice date, service date, statement date, balance due, amount due, payment terms, or total due. If no due date is printed, return null.

invoice_number.description: Unique invoice identifier assigned by the vendor for this invoice. Prefer the value in the invoice header or top-right invoice table that is directly labeled Invoice #, Invoice No., Invoice Number, Inv #, Inv No., Tax Invoice No., Bill Number, or Document Number. The invoice number is often near the invoice date. If the document includes both an invoice page and a work order page, prefer the value labeled Invoice # on the invoice page; use a standalone '#:' value on the work order page only if it matches the invoice page number. Return only the identifier value, not the label. Do not return P.O. No., PO #, PO number, job number, work order number, project number, reference number, customer number, account number, vendor GST number, tax ID, phone number, postal code, license number, product registration number, date, subtotal, GST amount, total amount, balance due, or service address.

po_or_job_number.description: Purchase order, job, work order, project, site reference, or reference number associated with the invoice. May be labeled PO #, P.O. No., Purchase Order, Job #, Job No., Work Order, WO, Project No., Project, Site Ref, Customer Ref, or Reference. If both PO and Job numbers exist, return both separated by a semicolon. Return null if no PO, job, work order, project, or reference number is present.

gst_amount.description: Goods and Services Tax amount charged on the invoice. In this prototype, GST means Canadian GST at 5%. Prefer the amount directly associated with labels such as GST, G.S.T., GST@5.0%, GST 5%, or Goods and Services Tax. Return the numeric money amount, not the GST rate. If both a GST line and a Total Tax line are shown and the amounts are the same, return the GST line amount. Use Total Tax only when there is no separate GST/G.S.T. line and no other tax types are present. Do not return the vendor GST registration number, GST account number, tax ID, subtotal, total invoice amount, balance due, line-item amount, rate, percentage, phone number, postal code, product registration number, or service license number.

subtotal_before_tax.description: Invoice subtotal before GST is added. Prefer values labeled Subtotal, Amount before GST, Total before GST, Net Amount, Pre-tax Amount, Taxable Amount, Cost of Service, or Service Amount. Do not return GST amount, Total Tax, final invoice total, Balance Due, Amount Due, Amount Paid, Rate, line item amount, or payment amount. Return null if no pre-GST subtotal is printed.

total_invoice_amount.description: Final invoice amount the customer is expected to pay, including GST and all charges. Prefer values labeled Total, Invoice Total, Amount Due, Balance Due, Total Due, Grand Total, Please Pay Total, Please Pay, or Amount Payable. If Total and Balance Due are both present and equal, return that amount. Do not return subtotal, GST amount, total tax, amount paid, rate, line amount, cost of service, or amount before tax.

service_address.description: Address where the work, service, delivery, repair, pest control visit, utility service, or job was performed. Prefer addresses labeled Ship To, Service Address, Service Location, Site Address, Job Address, Work Location, Property Address, Premises, Installation Address, or Service For. If both Invoice To/Bill To and Ship To/Service Address are present, return Ship To or Service Address. Do not return the vendor address. Do not return the Invoice To, Bill To, customer mailing address, remittance address, or vendor office address unless no service/site/ship-to address exists.

invoice_description.description: Generate one short sentence describing what this invoice is for. Use the invoice line item description, Service For field, work order title, service notes, or item description. The sentence must be 15 words or fewer. Do not include vendor name, invoice number, PO number, address, date, tax, total amount, payment status, or contact details. Do not mention GST. Use plain business wording. Example outputs: 'Rodent noise pest control service.' 'Lawn maintenance service.' 'Electrical repair work.' Return an empty string if the invoice purpose cannot be determined.

is_handwritten.description: Classify yes only when one or more critical AP fields are handwritten or manually filled: vendor name, invoice number, invoice date, payment due date, PO/job number, GST amount, total invoice amount, or service address. Classify no when the critical AP fields are printed, digitally generated, or clearly machine-readable, even if the document includes handwritten notes, signatures, technician notes, checkboxes, or service comments elsewhere.

vendor_category.description: Categorise the vendor as one of the listed values based on the type of goods or services provided on the invoice. Use utilities for electricity, gas, water, waste, telecom, or similar services. Use landscaping for lawn, grounds, tree, irrigation, or snow services. Use trades for construction, repair, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, restoration, or other skilled trade services. Use other when none of the categories clearly apply.

anomaly_flag.description: Note anything unusual about this invoice: missing critical fields, invoice number absent, payment due date absent, service address absent, GST/total arithmetic inconsistent, suspiciously round amounts with no itemisation, vendor name not matching the service region, duplicate-looking line items, or invoice total lower than GST. Return an empty string if nothing unusual is detected.
